_comment: Rules and thresholds for /project-costs-sync and /payout-run. Tunable data, never in a script or a prompt. Every decision cited here is recorded in methods/payouts.md (Decisions table) and the vault decision note.

write_mode._note: plan_only: scripts compute and write plan files; the command writes NOTHING to Notion. Flipping either to write is a dated decision recorded in the vault (05_decisions/), same as style-tags. The two Lightspeed writes are Phase 3 and are 'off' until a separate dated flip (plan Q2, amendment §9).

scope._note: Albert 2026-10-06: run only on projects from September 2026 onward. A project is in scope when its Project End Date is on or after this date. Older unpaid rows and projects with no end date are left out of the run and counted in summary.out_of_scope so nothing disappears silently; they stay Albert's to settle by hand. Applies to /payout-run and /project-costs-sync.

cadence._note: On the 1st, /payout-run waits for that day's 09:00 /project-costs-sync (checks ingest/<date>/run-ledger.json) or runs it first (amendment §10).

labor_release._note: Decision 2: customer balance never holds contractor pay; open work orders do. A WO with Charge to = Installer deducts its Budget Expense from that installer's held labor (Q5 default Titan).

band._note: Backstop for way-off totals (amendment §5). Computed from paid labor rows. A project type with fewer than min_samples_per_group uses the overall band.

flooring_cost._cost_stages_note: Albert 2026-10-06: the Flooring Line Item's Cost Rate ends at the ACTUAL invoiced price, net of credit memos (restocking fees included, spread over the sqft kept). Until then it carries the best ordered figure: supplier confirmation, else the LS purchase order. Every new invoice or credit re-proposes it; invoice_final ticks Cost Locked and a later credit updates a locked line with a changed_after_lock flag. Sold At Rate is the PM's quote rate (Quote Rate today, the Airtable quote push in Phase 3), never the Lightspeed sale price.
flooring_cost._source_of_truth_note: Albert 2026-10-06: the ordered material is the truth. Highest available of invoice > confirmation > LS PO sets the flooring cost; a sale line whose product or rate differs is flagged as a PM entry mistake (PP-461, PP-439). The sale is compared, never preferred.
flooring_cost._note: Amendment §2.3: PM (supplier PDF) -> front desk (stock order, wins interim) -> supplier invoice (final). Flag when PM vs front desk differs by more than $0.10/sqft, compared per sqft never on totals. No catalogue/Lightspeed auto-fill until the catalogue is reconciled (dated flip).

margin_floor._note: Amendment §6: flag any project below 20% margin computed on the post-discount total.

lightspeed._pp_regex_note: 3+ digits so PP-1000 is never read as PP-100 (amendment §1.1); leading boundary because lowercase 'pp' inside a word matched 5 old POs (verified 2026-10-06). Case-sensitive: real tags are always uppercase.
lightspeed._flooring_category_note: A sale line is FLOORING when its product's LS category leaf (lightspeed_pull.category_of) is one of these; any other known leaf (ACCESSORIES, ...) is NFM; no category -> 'unclassified' and flagged. Flooring quantity is already square feet on the LS line (verified: R-35833, qty 880 at $3.39 cost / $4.39 price per sqft).
lightspeed._parked_sale_note: Albert 2026-10-06: the project's Lightspeed sale exists to re-enter the materials as if sold to the client, so cost, profit and inventory are recorded in Lightspeed. It is completed after the fact, whenever Albert moves the money into Titan (the customer may have paid cash or to a personal account). So a parked sale is normal for a finished project, and its figures are final once Submission Status is one of these. A parked sale on a submitted project also means: money still to transfer into Titan, then close the sale.
lightspeed._zero_cost_note: Sale-line cost is FROZEN at sale time from inventory average_cost (stocked) or supply_price (non-stock); a later PO receipt never backfills it (verified 2026-10-06). These non-stock products legitimately carry cost 0 and are not flagged. Matched against product sku/handle/name, case-insensitive.

payments_match._note: Decision 12: suggest only; Albert confirms. auto_link stays false.

disposal._note: Q4 default + amendment §10: match by street and unit when present; more than one candidate project -> flag, never pick.

subject_patterns: ^Interac e-Transfer: Your \$([\d,]+\.\d{2}) transfer to (.+) has been successfully deposited\.?$
^Interac e-Transfer: (.+) has accepted your transfer of \$([\d,]+\.\d{2})\.?$
bank_cross_check._note: Decision 15: cross-check column only, never marks anything paid. BMO sends no 'you sent' email; these Interac notices are the only confirmation of a SENT transfer. Incoming 'You've received' notices are for payments_match only (amendment §10, clarified).
